Frequently Asked Questions

How does the QRIS payment work? +

After you click Pay Now, we generate a universal QRIS code you can scan with any Indonesian e-wallet or banking app. You have 15 minutes to complete the payment.

When will I receive my invitation? +

Your invitation link is generated automatically the moment your payment is confirmed and sent to your email instantly.

What is the WhatsApp RSVP add-on? +

For IDR 50.000, guests can confirm their attendance with one tap on WhatsApp — no app install or account needed.
